generate_MMFusionNLG: generate text captions from video features using the MMFusionNLG model with bos and eos token ids
forward_MMFusionNLG: run a forward pass through MMFusionNLG with caption tokens, video features, and masks to get logits
generate_MMBertForNLG: generate text sequences from video embeddings using MMBertForNLG with beam search or greedy decoding
forward_MMBertForNLG: run a forward pass through MMBertForNLG with input ids and video embeds to compute prediction scores
prepare_inputs_for_generation_MMBertForN: prepare and trim attention masks and token type ids for MMBertForNLG generation steps
